segments.title: Cold Open: Copyright Strike Crisis & Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Case battles nine YouTube copyright strikes on recent VODs while Pepito runs cold open; Hype Train appears for a bird-themed freestyle that spirals into toe-licking surrealism before being dismissed.

segments.title: U.S. Seizes Venezuelan Oil Tanker; Trump Gold Card Launches
segments.notes: Case covers the Coast Guard seizure of a sanctioned Iranian-Venezuelan tanker off Venezuela's coast, Trump's 'largest tanker ever' rhetoric, and the immediate pivot to advertising the $5M Trump Gold Card visa program.

segments.title: Canyon Crest Academy Gym Rented for Adult-Content Stream
segments.notes: Local NBC report on Wubby's 24-hour Twitch stream sponsored by an adult site featuring scantily clad performers, toe-sucking, and a staged crucifixion; school district claims rental agreement violated.

segments.title: Lightning Bum: British Colloquialism for Rectal Electric Shocks
segments.notes: Medical segment on 'lightning bum' — sudden sharp rectal pain from nerve misfires — with Case admitting he experiences it and Hype Train joking about electric butt plugs.

segments.title: Dakota Johnson Praises Saudi Film Industry
segments.notes: Case dissects Johnson's claim that Saudi Arabia renewed her faith in cinema, questioning celebrity propaganda junkets funded by the Saudi royal family.

segments.title: Swedish Musician Teaches Octopus Jazz Piano
segments.notes: Brief palate cleanser: video of an octopus playing piano keys in a jazz style; Case declares mission accomplished.

segments.title: San Francisco Woman Gives Birth in Waymo Robotaxi
segments.notes: Waymo rider support detected unusual activity and called 911; Case jokes about surge pricing for the newborn passenger.

segments.title: Nick Fuentes Admits Attraction to Women, Denies Women Voting Rights
segments.notes: Case watches clip of Fuentes telling Piers Morgan he's attracted to women but believes they shouldn't vote; Case dismisses him as a grifting rage-baiter from the mid-2010s.

segments.title: New York Times Vows to Cover Trump's Health Despite Threats
segments.notes: Case notes the Times' belated willingness to report on the president's visible decline, while mocking his own attempts to say something clip-proof about Hitler.

segments.title: Gernon Competition Returns; Kendelle in Philadelphia
segments.notes: Case mentions the annual face-gurning contest Gernon; reveals Kendelle is eating expensive steaks in Philly with Tucker Roberts (G4) and watching AEW Dynamite.

segments.title: JD Vance's Five-Year-Old Goes 'Absolutely Nuts' Over Bible Page 66-77
segments.notes: Vance tweets about his son repeating 'six seven' during church reading; In-N-Out preemptively removes the number combo from its ordering system.

segments.title: Glenn Beck Interviews AI George Washington on BlazeTV
segments.notes: AI Washington delivers 29-point referenced lecture; Beck asks him to 'dumb it down'; Case mocks the slave-teeth rendering and the perpetual AI founder feedback loop.

segments.title: Study: Women's Farts Smell Worse Due to Hydrogen Sulfide Concentration
segments.notes: Case concedes the point to women; Kendelle's theoretical flatulence perfection is invoked.

segments.title: In-N-Out Removes '6/7' From Menu After Vance Tweet
segments.notes: Chain scrubs the number combo; Case claims the trend will die once old people adopt it.

segments.title: Chinese Man Spends $70K on Hello Kitty Parthenon Proposal
segments.notes: Custom-built Hello Kitty Parthenon in Shenyang sets viral proposal bar; Case brainstorms Beyblade-ring and Love Is Blind set ideas for his own eventual proposal.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein Intercepts Park Opinions Amid Bush-Spraying Ultimatum
segments.notes: Trip (as Trippy B) fields opinions: a petition to chain Crum and dump him in a dirty river (signed on a used coaster), Rob serving Santa a restraining order, an e-bike rider demanding right-of-way, a homeless 'CEO of Being Energy' selling 'Bug!' energy drink, Peter Thiel on ketamine claiming to be a flower, and a llama substitute for Jeff Ripple that spits on Trip.

segments.title: Bidets vs. Garden Hoses: The Great Anal Hygiene Debate
segments.notes: Munch champions bidets; Crum argues for high-pressure garden hoses through the window, revealing his butt-toy collection and admitting he enjoys anal stimulation; debate ends in mutual disgust and Crum declaring spiritual victory.

segments.title: Sign-Off: Raid to Raz; Pepito's Ontological Dog Assertion
segments.notes: Case raids Raz after considering Wubby and Sasha Grey; Pepito insists he is a dog and always will be; Case confirms Kendelle returns tomorrow.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Ran cold open countdown, managed copyright strike triage, asserted he is a dog, and claimed demonic puppetry knowledge of Entourage.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derailed bird-themed freestyle into toe-licking and bird-foot-tongue-butt club fantasy before being dismissed by Case.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for garden-hose anal cleaning, revealed butt-toy ownership, admitted enjoying anal stimulation, and claimed spiritual victory over Munch.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defended bidets against Crum's garden-hose regimen, deployed 'bros before hose' line, and ended debate in mutual disgust.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted Trip on the Street from a park with new EV charger, interviewed a llama substitute for Jeff Ripple, and received bush-spraying eviction notice.

storylines.beat: [01:23:48] Chat suggests taping engagement ring to a Beyblade for proposal; Case acknowledges the idea as 'something' — active community pledge storyline referenced.

lore_notes.fact: Case has lost ~25 pounds in the last three months from working out again.
Kendelle is in Philadelphia eating expensive steaks with Tucker Roberts (G4) and watching AEW Dynamite.
Kendelle does not want a public proposal, family involvement, or a Disney proposal.
Kendelle is allergic to cats but owns two cats; no regrets.
Trip's bush manager (Hank) informs Trip the bush will be sprayed tomorrow at 10 AM; Trip refuses to leave.
In-N-Out officially removed '6/7' from its ordering system after JD Vance's viral tweet about his son.
Chinese man spent $70K on a custom Hello Kitty Parthenon for a proposal in Shenyang.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell navigates a chaotic mid-week broadcast plagued by nine YouTube copyright strikes and technical failures, covering the U.S. seizure of a Venezuelan oil tanker, a San Diego high school gym rented for an adult-content stream, and a viral $70K Hello Kitty Parthenon proposal. The show features a Hype Train derailment about bird feet, a Trip on the Street segment disrupted by a llama substitute for Jeff Ripple, and a Munch & Crum debate on bidets versus garden hoses that devolves into Crum's anal hygiene confessions and butt-toy collection reveal.
